intro: The Relics of Wakening is an urgent rescue mission to save the Druids of the Talon slumbering within the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun the sacred mounds, endangering the dormant druids whose spirits wander the Emerald Dream. Without these four specific ritual artifacts, the sleepers cannot safely be roused back into the waking world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Gnarlpine invaders were seen ravaging the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.
The slumbering druids will be trapped in the Emerald Dream for eternity, unaware of their fate, unless we help. The delicate hibernation ritual cannot be broken without the Relics of Wakening.

Journey to the Den and retrieve the Raven Claw Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting. The druids store them in sacred chests. Return them to me and I will prepare the awakening ritual.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, the kidnapped Druids of the Talon will be forever trapped in the Emerald Dream if we cannot retrieve the Relics of Wakening from the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.
For every minute we delay their fate comes one step closer to eternal doom.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have succeeded, young adventurer! Well done. And just in time I might add.
